project: Wuxia Life P49 Sample Lines Validation And Playtest
description: Plan the validation, replay, and human playtest work that determines whether the three 0-40 minimum playable life samples are stable, readable, distinct, and worth continuing or replaying.

userStories.title: Define the validation contract for the three sample lines
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an explicit validation contract for the three sample lines so closure is judged against a stable bar instead of taste alone.
acceptanceCriteria: Define pass, warning, and fail interpretations for the three sample lines
Define the minimum simulation and human-evidence bundle
State that gate pass is not the only closure signal
Save the contract under docs/test-reports/

userStories.title: Define fixed-seed replay coverage for orthodox martial
userStories.description: As a tester, I want a fixed-seed replay plan for the orthodox line so its 0-40 sample can be rechecked consistently after later changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the orthodox fixed seed and key checkpoint ages
Define the required key nodes and identity signals
Define the required cost or fallback signals
Record the replay specification in the PRD

userStories.title: Define cross-line comparison dimensions
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want explicit comparison dimensions across the three lines so validation focuses on readable life differences rather than hidden implementation differences.

acceptanceCriteria: Define post-run retell questions

userStories.title: Split replay harness work into small tasks
userStories.description: As an implementer, I want replay-harness work split into small tasks so validation tooling can be added incrementally and rechecked often.
acceptanceCriteria: Split fixed-seed matrix definition into a standalone task
Split checkpoint-output work into a standalone task

userStories.title: Define final closure evidence
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want explicit final closure evidence so the project can say whether the three minimum playable life samples are actually ready to serve as the next experience baseline.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the required script outputs for final closure

Define which residual warnings remain acceptable

Record the closure rules in the PRD
